title: Mall world during hypnosis
content: Hello! I have been dreaming of a mall or airport world nearly once a week for the last 3 years. I was curious about it but never really questioned it. I figured it was some place I had created mentally as a safe space. I commonly see escalators in a glass and stainless steel cordor, a theater with stars on the carpet ans red and purple walls, and a food court on a second floor with a small bakery cafe and Thai place next to it. It was pleasant to be in and sometimes I encountered people from my past who I had connected with about spirituality. During a hypnosis session I had last year, with a unrelated purpose, I asked they hypnotherapist to ask me about the mall world. During our session I mentioned that it was a common space on the Astral where beings could interact safely. No violence was allowed to occur there. Just though you guys might find this interesting!
